text:
maya: Quick idea for tightening postmortem follow-ups without adding overhead. Proposal: a single remediation checklist card that's required on all P1/P2 postmortems + minor changes to IC rotation. Short thread.

maya: Remediation checklist (saved template):
- remediation id
- short goal (one line)
- owner (team/person)
- ETA (ISO date)
- verification test / success metric
- rollback/mitigation criteria
- recurrence flag (yes/no) + signal to watch
- status (todo/in-progress/blocked/done)

rachael: love the verification test line. often actions are vague and never validated. can we make ETA required for anything not done within 72h?

maya: yes — rule: if status != done at T+72h, owner must set ETA and post a 1-line blocker note. ops-bot can enforce.

alexc: on IC rotation: propose 2-week primary IC, 1-week shadow handoff before primary steps down. shadow is expected to observe and take over if needed. reduces knowledge gap during handoffs.

priya: ops-bot note: I can add a webhook that creates a checklist card in our incident tracker when we mark postmortem type=P1 or P2. Card includes fields above and auto-assigns T+72 reminder.

ops-bot: webhook_created -> tracker_card for thread 2311112222, reminder=T+72.

jamal: for recurrence detection, can we add a lightweight signal: if same service has >2 incidents with same root keyword in 90d, auto-tag threads with "recurrence-check" and create a short triage meeting invite? keeps us from missing patterns.

rachael: +1. keep the triage meeting to 30m max and focus on pattern hypothesis + quick mitigations. make sure product/CS are invited if customer impact.

maya: sample timeline (minimal):
- T+0: incident declared, IC assigned, initial triage note in channel with Impact tags (latency/errors/data-loss)
- T+24: triage summary + temp mitigations
- T+72: remediation card created + owners assigned + ETA required if not done
- T+14d: remediation sprint snapshot (status update)
- T+30d: recurrence signal review (metrics + logs)
- T+90d: closure or long-term plan recorded

alexc: can we add a tiny SLO impact field to the remediation card so owners know how strictly to prioritize? e.g. P0/P1/secondary.

maya: added SLO impact field to the template.

priya: I'll wire the tracker API today. ops-bot will post the card link in-thread and ping owner at T+72 and weekly until done.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled -> "T+72 remediation check" for thread 2311112222.

jamal: I'll volunteer to run a 3-incident pattern sweep next month to validate the recurrence thresholds and report back.

rachael: please drop a 1-line ack when you accept ownership so ops-bot can tag the card.

alexc: ack. will update runbook to include 1-week shadow for IC handoffs.

jamal: ack. I'll take the pattern sweep and lead the pilot.

maya: thanks. next steps: priya wires tracker, ops-bot enforces T+72 rule, alexc updates runbook, jamal runs sweep. we'll review pilot results at the monthly oncall retro.

ops-bot: reminder closed -> "T+72 remediation check" for thread 2311112222."
